synthesis:draft.headline: Five‑minute RRP peak 4981.0 $/MWh at 2026-07-31 02:05 ACST
summary: A sustained high‑price episode affected SA1 between 2026-07-30T04:30:00Z and 2026-07-30T22:20:00Z; the five‑minute peak RRP was 4981.0 $/MWh at 2026-07-31 02:05 ACST (evidence ev0433, ev1017, ev1018).
Across the window 214 five‑minute intervals were at-or-above the analysis threshold of 300.0 $/MWh (evidence ev0884, ev0885).
Dispatch TOTALDEMAND at the five‑minute price peak (interval end 2026-07-31 02:05 ACST) was 1472.82 MW (dispatch TOTALDEMAND, evidence ev0434).
The half‑hour containing the price extreme (peak half‑hour end 2026-07-30T17:00:00Z / 2026-07-31 02:30 ACST) had operational demand 1466.0 MW (evidence ev0910).
The window maximum half‑hour operational demand reported was 2173.0 MW at 2026-07-30T09:30:00Z (evidence ev0895).
The unweighted mean of five‑minute RRP over the window was 416.71 $/MWh (evidence ev0883).

possible_explanations.statement: A tight local supply margin in some five‑minute dispatch intervals might have allowed very high offers to set price; testing requires dispatch marginal‑unit and offer data for the high‑price five‑minute intervals.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Obtain the dispatch marginal unit and offer prices for the five‑minute intervals flagged in ev0884 and the interval ending 2026-07-31 02:05 ACST (the peak) and check which offers set the marginal price.

possible_explanations.statement: Interconnector transfer capability or planned outage notices might have limited imports and could be relevant (see the Tailem_Bnd to South_East planned‑outage notice [c2]).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Inspect interconnector limit/availability logs and constraint binding reports for the window 2026-07-30T04:30:00Z to 2026-07-31T05:00:00Z and compare to the high‑price intervals identified in ev0884.

possible_explanations.statement: A local network incident might have altered local operational conditions (the AEMO notice reports a City West transformer and circuit‑breaker trip [c1]), which could be relevant to system configuration or constraint activations.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Review the contingency/incident logs, constraint activations and any reconfiguration instructions around the notice time to see if constraint sets or dispatch actions changed following the event described in [c1].

citations.quote: At 1140 hrs, the City West 275/66 kV transformer T_1 and the 275 kV circuit breaker 6675 tripped during restoration of City West 275/66 kV transformer T_2.
citations.supports: Reports a non‑credible contingency event (transformer and circuit breaker trip) in SA on 30/07/2026 which is relevant to local operational conditions.

citations.quote: A planned outage of Tailem_Bnd to South_East No 2 275kV LINE  - SA region - 01/08/2026.
citations.supports: Reports a planned inter‑regional transfer limit variation (planned outage of Tailem_Bnd to South_East) that could affect transfer capability around the event window.

Constraint binding reports / executed constraint equations for the high‑price intervals (to see which constraints were active and their marginal effects).
Comprehensive outage and availability logs for generation units and interconnectors for 28 July–1 August 2026 (to confirm reduced capability beyond the notices retrieved).
